recommended_remediation_gates.description: 13 targets: Vanguard 'Morningstar' branding prefix absent from filing-date source (8 targets); VNQI/VCLT/VXUS/VT suffix 'ETF' vs 'Index Fund' (4 targets); QARP doubled 'ETF ETF' (1 target). Manifest legal_name must be patched from authoritative EDGAR source for the filing date.

12 targets: IWF/IWV/IWO 'Fund' vs 'ETF' suffix mismatch prevents section lookup (3); 9 BNE targets where fund name found in source but complex HTML table prevents boundary detection (FLTB, MBBB, MIG, EQL, IGIB, IYC, IYK, EQIN, TBIL). DOC_INDEX_V1_3_0 required.

83 targets across SPDR Series Trust (CIK 0001064642, 20 targets), Schwab Strategic Trust (0001168164, 14), SPDR Index Shares Funds (0001064641, 11), Tidal/Touchstone (0001919700, 7), Fidelity (0001849998, 7+1 genuine), and others. Strategy section present in source but extractor cannot locate it: SPDR uses table-embedded 'Investment Objective' headings; Tidal uses 'Investment Goal' variant; iShares uses non-standard heading variants. MANDATE_PARSER_V1_4_0 required.
1 target: QSIX (Pacer Metaurus Nasdaq 100 Dividend Multiplier ETF). 4 legal name occurrences found in source but series boundary detection algorithm failed. SERIES_RESOLVER_V1_4_0 required.

1 target: VGK. Selector chose 16MB combined statutory prospectus (449 Vanguard fund mentions). Per-fund 497K should have been selected instead. STATUTORY_FILING_SELECTOR_V1_5_0 with document-size guard required.
